A1.justification: Both complete 17-page PDFs describe the same CoMo work. Their text, equations, figures, tables and Appendix A.1–A.6 are readable and directly comparable.

before.justification: v2 reports original LIBERO and CALVIN experiments, real-world Franka evaluations, and dual-arm/humanoid analyses in Tables 1–5, with additional qualitative results in Appendix A.5.

after.justification: v3 retains these original simulation, real-world and representation-analysis results, including the appendix visualizations.

M1.justification: The temporal difference mechanism, temporal contrastive loss, IDM–FDM architecture and unified diffusion/autoregressive policy procedures remain unchanged.

E1.justification: Both retain SAM-V, EgoVid and Droid training data, and the same LIBERO, CALVIN, Franka, RoboTwin and EgoVLA evaluation coverage. No tasks or test scenarios are added or removed.

E2.justification: Table 3 renames GR00T to GR00T-like without changing its scores or comparator membership. Section 4.2.3 already describes incorporating comparator designs into the shared diffusion policy in both versions.

E3.justification: Evaluation settings remain identical, including 10 labeled trajectories per LIBERO task, CALVIN ABC→D evaluation, real-world demonstration budgets and rollout counts, and the appendix training configurations.

E4.justification: The same component ablations, latent-dimension scaling analysis, embodiment comparisons and FDM visualization studies are retained. The Table 1 summary-value correction does not introduce or redesign an analysis.

E5.justification: Both retain three LIBERO evaluation runs and mean/standard-deviation reporting. No run counts, uncertainty-reporting practices or statistical procedures change.

E6.justification: Table 1 changes the discrete baseline's average S-PCFC from 0.4810 to -0.0678. The four unchanged suite values (-0.0501, -0.1521, -0.0649 and -0.0040) average to -0.067775, supporting the correction. Other results and rankings remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The contrastive-loss equations and mathematical definition of S-PCFC remain identical. No formal assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about continuous latent motion, mitigating shortcut learning, zero-shot pseudo-label generation and unified policy learning.

C2.justification: The explanations of Td/Tcl synergy and the relationship between representation metrics and policy performance remain unchanged. Section 6 retains the same applicability qualifications and limitations.

D1.justification: Appendix A and Tables 6–8 retain identical hardware, data-processing, architecture and training details. Code availability and access information are unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion and all 85 references are unchanged. GR00T-like clarifies a table label consistently with the adaptation already documented, without substantively revising research positioning.

P1.justification: Table 3 changes the name GR00T to GR00T-like, and the first-page arXiv version/date stamp is updated. The remaining prose, terminology and document organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Table 3 receives a limited displayed row-label refinement from GR00T to GR00T-like. Figure designs, captions, table structures and page layout remain unchanged; the number-only correction in Table 1 is assessed under E6.

improvement.justification: v3 fixes an internally inconsistent Table 1 average and clarifies that the Table 3 comparator is GR00T-like, matching the existing implementation description. These changes provide a limited improvement in numerical accuracy and clarity while leaving the methods, evidence coverage and conclusions unchanged.
